summary: Rename/move a filesystem entry with Node/OS rename semantics rather than generic copy-delete behavior.

semantics.atomicity: inherits underlying OS rename behavior where supported

caveats: Cross-device renames can fail instead of transparently copying.
Replacement behavior differs for files/directories and across OSes.
Do not emulate with copy+delete; that changes atomicity, metadata, links, and failure behavior.

tests.name: source moves
tests.expected_behavior: a is gone and b refers to the moved file containing x
